subTitle:
A diferencia del Spot Grid tradicional (que requiere definir un precio límite superior fijo) o del Trailing Up, el Infinity Grid está diseñado para acompañar el crecimiento de un activo sin importar qué tan alto llegue su precio, manteniendo siempre la misma proporción del valor de tu portafolio invertida en el token.
Es la estrategia preferida por inversores de ciclo completo en $BTC, $ETH y $BNB que buscan tomar ganancias parciales en las subidas e inmediatamente recomprar en los retrocesos, sin el riesgo de vender todo su inventario.
1. ¿Cómo funciona la Grilla Infinita?
El algoritmo del Infinity Grid opera bajo una premisa matemática simple y efectiva:
Mantenimiento del Valor Base: El bot busca mantener constante el valor equivalente en USDT de tu posición de cripto inicial.Toma de Ganancias Automática: A medida que el precio sube por encima de un porcentaje determinado (ej. 1%), el bot vende la fracción excedente de cripto para asegurar Grid Profit en USDT, manteniendo el valor inicial intacto.Recompra Sistemática: Si el precio retrocede, el bot utiliza los USDT disponibles para comprar más unidades con descuento, preparándose para la siguiente ola alcista.
2. Parámetros Fundamentales de Configuración
Límite Inferior (Floor Price): Establece únicamente un precio mínimo de protección (soporte mayor). Mientras el precio no caiga de este nivel, el bot operará indefinidamente hacia arriba.Porcentaje por Grilla (Profit per Grid): Define la distancia de disparo (habitualmente entre 0.5% y 2.0%).Sin Límite Superior: No necesitas adivinar dónde estará el techo del mercado ni reprogramar rangos constantemente.
3. Consejo Táctico Express (Ideal para iniciar hoy)
💡 El "Tip" del Acumulador: Si tu visión sobre $BTC, $ETH o $BNB es alcista a medio/largo plazo y no quieres gestionar activamente tus posiciones, despliega un Infinity Grid seleccionando un límite inferior un 15%-20% por debajo del precio actual. 一、先看看今天的基本盘

今天是2026年9月16日，星期三。

昨天我们在封面里写的“危日·忌开市”，今天打开盘面一看—— 不仅应验了，还加倍奉还。

#BTC 今天凌晨在CLARITY法案投票结果出炉后急速下挫，一度跌至75000美元附近，随后小幅反弹至76000上方，现报约75893美元，24小时跌幅约1.76%。#ETH 跌幅更深，报2404.83美元，24小时跌幅3.23%。山寨币全线走弱：#XRP 下跌7.46%、#Solana 下跌3.67%、#狗狗币 下跌3.14%。
{spot}(BTCUSDT)
最刺眼的数字是这个：恐慌贪婪指数从昨天的69直接砸到51，一天之内跌了18个点，降幅26.1%，市场情绪从“贪婪”正式切换为“中性”。

BTC市占率上升到59.04%，ETH市占率下降到11.35%。翻译一下：资金在从山寨往大饼跑，这不是普跌，是“逃命式抱团”。

衍生品市场方面，24小时交易量9328.6亿美元，较前一日增加18.76%。稳定币24小时交易量增加21.44%至1040.4亿美元。一边是衍生品交易量暴涨，一边是稳定币交易量暴涨——恐慌的人在赌方向，聪明的人在换子弹。

二、今天的核心事件：CLARITY法案49:50折戟，市场应声而落

美国参议院就《数字资产市场清晰法案》（CLARITY Act）举行的终止辩论表决，最终以49票赞成、50票反对告终，远未触及60票的通过门槛。

注意一个关键细节：共和党拥有53个席位，但至少有3人没有投赞成票。连自家人都没拢住，这个结果比市场预期的还要差。

核心卡点是什么？特朗普家族的加密利益冲突。 民主党谈判代表Mark Warner投下反对票时表示，尽管执法和国家安全争议接近解开，但公职人员从加密行业获利的利益冲突问题仍未解决。参议员卢米斯的发言人直言：“如果民主党真心想达成协议，应该真正开始谈，而不是把原先的诉求再递一遍还称作进展。”

市场反应有多剧烈？

比特币在投票结果出炉后短暂下挫至75000美元附近。加密概念股集体承压：Coinbase跌超11%、Circle跌超12%、Robinhood和MicroStrategy同步走低。

更值得关注的是预测市场Polymarket上的数据：该法案在2026年底前正式成为法律的概率，从周初的30%以上急剧缩水至约5%。

从30%到5%，这不是下调预期，这是“棺材板钉死了”。 行业对年内能否重新组建60票联盟感到迷茫，目前尚无明确的时间表。
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
三、玄学时间：癸巳日“成日”，先难后易四个字今天写得明明白白

查一下今天的黄历：

2026年9月16日，农历八月初六，丙午年丁酉月癸巳日。十二建星：成日。值神：朱雀（凶）。

“成日”在十二建星里的定义是：“成就之意，谋事先难后易，多成少败之象，大吉之日。 ”宜祈福、嫁娶、交易、开业、求职、领证、搬家、任职等吉事可成。忌诉讼、官司。

“先难后易”四个字，今天在盘面上写得清清楚楚。

凌晨CLARITY法案折戟，BTC急跌到75000——这是“先难”。然后价格从75000反弹回76000附近，跌幅从4%收窄至1.76%——这是“后易”。

再看值神朱雀。朱雀主口舌、是非、文书纠纷。今天是什么日子？参议院投票日。 两党在国会山吵了一整天，49票赞成、50票反对，共和党内部3人倒戈，民主党全员反对。这不就是“朱雀”能量的最佳注脚吗？口舌之争，文书受阻，官非缠身。

但“成日”的底色是“大吉” 。朱雀再凶，也压不住“成日”先难后易的格局。今天的“难”已经兑现了——法案没过，市场跌了。接下来要看的是“易”能走多远。

另外一个值得注意的细节：今日日柱癸巳，癸水为阴水，巳火为阴火。水火交泰，聚势纳财。有水有火，水火既济之象。对加密货币这个“水属性资产”来说，今天是“水火相济”——水被火蒸，短期受压；但火被水济，中期反而有托底。
{spot}(SOLUSDT)
四、比特币的八字走到哪一步了？

今年丙午年，火气极旺。早前有交易员给比特币排八字，结论是“火冲财库，2026年为比特币的至暗时刻”。但更细的拆解一直是：上半年“火劫归渊”，下半年“金鲤跃渊”。

9月是丁酉月，酉金当令。金生水，理论上对加密资产有利。但今年的火太猛，火克金——金气虽然在长，但还没有长到能压住火的程度。

今天癸巳日，癸水入库，巳火透干。水被火蒸，短期承压。但巳中藏丙火、庚金、戊土——火中有金，金中有水。 这意味着今天的下跌不是单向的，里面藏着反弹的种子。

秋分在9月23日08:04到来。秋分之后，金气进入全年最旺的阶段。从五行角度看，那才是水属性资产真正获得支撑的节点。今天的急跌，恰好是“最后一哆嗦”的候选之一。

五、天王星逆行第6天：信息迷雾正在散去，但真相还没浮出水面

天王星在双子座逆行已进入第6天。双子座掌管信息、通讯、媒体，天王星代表突变和颠覆。当天王星在双子座逆行，整个社会的“信息验证系统”进入混乱期。

今天CLARITY法案的投票过程就是最好的例子：共和党说这是“最后、最好且最终”的方案，民主党说要“更多修改”；预测平台说只有18%过关概率，Coinbase CEO说“即使没通过也是好结果”；参议员Tillis把票从赞成改成了反对，但说“这不是该法案的终点”。

同一件事，五种说法，六种解读。 这就是天王星逆行双子座的能量场——真相被撕成碎片，散落在不同人的嘴里。

但注意一个关键信号：天王星逆行初期的混乱能量在9月16日前后达到峰值。 而FOMC决议在9月17日凌晨公布。信息迷雾的峰值，恰好撞上货币政策落地的时刻。 这意味着：当所有人都在被CLARITY法案的噪音牵着走的时候，真正的方向选择，可能来自一个完全不同的变量。

六、玄学操作节奏（仅供娱乐）

今天9月16日（癸巳日，成日，朱雀值神）：已应验“先难后易”。 凌晨法案折戟砸出75000低点，随后反弹至76000附近。今天的“难”已经兑现了，“易”能走多远，取决于76000能不能站稳。玄学建议：今天的操作窗口在反弹确认之后，不在急跌之中。

今晚至明天凌晨2:00：FOMC才是真正的“哨响”。

昨天我们说“迷雾里，等那声哨响”。CLARITY法案的投票结果是一声哨响，但它不是主哨，是开场哨。真正的重头戏在北京时间9月17日凌晨2:00——美联储FOMC利率决议。

目前加息25个基点的概率已飙至86%。如果加息落地且沃什释放鹰派信号，BTC可能再次测试75000下方。如果加息落地但措辞偏鸽，或者干脆“加息落地即利空出尽”，78000上方的期权仓位会开始发力。

9月17日（甲午日，收日）：FOMC后的“应激恢复期”。 黄历显示明天是“收日”——收获、收成之意，功德圆满之象，大吉之日。如果FOMC没有带来毁灭性利空，明天大概率会有一波情绪修复。

9月23日秋分之后：金气最旺的窗口正式开启。 从五行角度，秋分后金气达到全年峰值，对水属性的加密资产形成最有力的支撑。如果FOMC没有造成趋势性破坏，秋分后的BTC有望重新挑战78000-80000区间。

风水方位提醒：今日煞东，冲猪。如果你在家盯盘，今天别面朝正东。财神位在正南，喜神位在东南，福神位在正西。但朱雀值神当道，方位参考意义有限——今天最该待的方位是“不动”。

穿衣玄学：今天大吉色是黄色、米色、棕色（五行属土，土克水，稳住底盘）。次吉色是红色、橙色、粉色（五行属火，与今日五行相同）。不宜穿金银白（五行属金，今日所克）。

七、最后说句人话

今天的关键词是四个字：先难后易。

CLARITY法案49:50折戟，BTC从77000上方砸到75000，这是“难”。恐慌贪婪指数一天跌18个点，从贪婪到中性，这也是“难”。

但跌幅在收窄，BTC从75000反弹回76000，ETH守在2400上方，这是“易”的信号。

明天凌晨2:00，FOMC。这才是本周的终局之战。

成日说：先难后易，多成少败。
朱雀说：口舌是非已过，接下来看真章。
癸巳日说：水火交泰，聚势纳财。

三套系统指向同一个结论：今天的“难”是入场券，明天的“易”才是正餐。但正餐之前，先确认FOMC不会掀桌子。

明天凌晨见分晓。

Just imagine you blink eye and loss $7.8M, Yes it is not a joke it happened today

$7.8M was stored in a multi signature wallet

The Safe itself wasn’t hacked

The owner keys weren’t cracked

Kelp wasn’t insolvent

So how did the money disappear?

A user had enabled an automation/module stack that could move funds without requiring a fresh multisig signature every time. One of those components exposed a dangerous authorization path.

An attacker found it.

In roughly 24 seconds, they deployed a worthless token, created a Uniswap v4 pool against rsETH collateral, and prepared the extraction.

Then the memepool comes into the scene

A searcher called “Yoink” copied the profitable transaction, got it into block #1, and captured roughly 2,900 rsETH worth about $7.8M before the original exploit could suceceed

That creates an even stranger situation

The attacker lost the money they were trying to steal

But the searcher that front-ran the exploit got the assets instead

And no, that doesn’t automatically make Yoink a whitehat. The funds were not returned to the victim, and Yoink later liquidated additional collateral from the same position

The bigger lesson for crypto users is much more uncomfortable:

A multisig can have strong owner security while still carrying dangerous permissions that the owner grant.

Every module, router, keeper and automation contract expands the attack surface.

The blockchain may be working exactly as designed.

Your permission model can still be broken.

That’s the part people usually notice only after millions are gone.

I explained the risks in my previous posts. I can provide a detailed answer to your question. 

A coin that is not listed on Binance spot, is traded only on futures, and will experience a large-scale unlock (supply increase) 5 days later (21 September 2026) could be high-risk for people trading futures.

Even though Binance doesn’t have a spot market for it, other major centralized exchanges like Ake token, Gate, KuCoin, and MEXC are actively trading it on their spot markets.

Market makers and insiders who will buy ahead of the unlock lock in their risk (hedge) by buying spot Ake from other exchanges and opening massive short positions in Binance’s futures market.

The funding rate on Binance Futures is calculated based on the index price formed from the average of spot prices on other exchanges. Since spot is continuously sold on external exchanges, even if the Binance futures price rises, the positive funding rate remains weak.

A funding rate at the 4H level of %0,02828 (8H ~%0,056) for an altcoin that has surged this aggressively and steeply can be considered extraordinarily weak. Under normal circumstances, in such parabolic moves, funding rates would typically peak (%0,1, %0,2 and above).

Please pay attention to this (!): On the date 5 days from now (21 September 2026), a large unlock of 2.13 billion tokens will take place. Before that, whales holding large amounts of coins may be trying to keep the price sideways (during the distribution phase) and get smaller investors to trade inside. The reason the price doesn’t drop hard is likely the sell pressure from above. The reason it can’t move sharply down is possibly real profit-taking sales that are queued up above. The day before yesterday I said I planned to short the “side consort.” 2550 and 2580 were both short positions. The decline came as expected, hitting a low of 2360. There should still be room below, but it would be best to reduce position size, because the recent market has been washing back and forth too intensely. Even if the bearish move is coming, it doesn’t come cleanly. In such a market, it’s better to leave some room to do “T” trades.

After tonight, there will be a rate decision at around midnight. The outcome can only be whether they hike by how much or don’t hike at all. Of course, there’s also a small possibility of a rate cut. For this kind of data-driven market, it’s better to stay flat in advance—don’t gamble.

As for the rate hike uncertainty: if a 25-basis-point hike is implemented, then it will definitely be a drop first followed by a rise. There will likely be a downward “needle” move, and then the market should return to the current range where it’s consolidating. If they hike more, the drop would be bigger. If they don’t hike, the subsequent rebound will be relatively strong.

I mentioned earlier that after this big rally, there needs to be a pullback for it to qualify as a proper bull market. 75000 is clearly not enough; I think 73000 or even lower is the best kind of pullback. But trying to call the bottom is not right—you can only observe as you go. As long as price pulls back downward and then returns to this current range again, you can confirm that this is indeed a bull market, and you don’t need to keep wavering. If it falls back below 70000, then you can’t keep imagining this is a bull market anymore.

My personal view still leans toward a bull market. On the weekly timeframe, the divergence after the move up of around 20,000 points isn’t that much, and this time the initial bottoming and accumulation period was long enough. There’s still plenty of room above. #ETH

title: Deutsche Bank to Offer Bitcoin, Ether Custody to European Institutions
subTitle:
Deutsche Bank’s new digital asset custody service means institutional investors can finally store $BTC and $ETH safely in Europe.

---

Hook:  
Did you know that until now, most European institutions had to rely on foreign custodians to hold their crypto assets? Deutsche Bank’s upcoming launch changes that.

The Concept  
Custody is the secure storage of digital assets, similar to how a bank holds your cash in a vault. For crypto, it means protecting private keys, ensuring compliance, and providing insurance. Deutsche Bank is planning to roll out a European custody solution this year, initially covering Bitcoin ($BTC), Ethereum ($ETH), and a handful of stablecoins. This move signals that traditional finance is catching up with the crypto world, offering a trusted bridge for institutional players who need regulatory compliance and robust security.

Real‑World Example  
Imagine a European pension fund that wants to allocate a portion of its portfolio to $BTC. Previously, the fund would have to send its assets to a custodian outside the EU, navigating cross‑border regulations and potential data privacy issues. With Deutsche Bank’s custody, the pension fund can keep its holdings within the EU, benefit from local regulatory oversight, and still enjoy the liquidity and growth potential of $BTC and $ETH. The bank’s infrastructure will handle key management, transaction signing, and audit trails, giving investors peace of mind.

Takeaway  
If you’re an institutional investor or a crypto‑savvy portfolio manager, keep an eye on Deutsche Bank’s rollout. It could become the go-to solution for secure, compliant crypto holdings in Europe. Consider how this might simplify your asset management and reduce regulatory friction.

Engagement Question  
What other digital assets would you want a European custodian to support next? #CryptoCustody #DeutscheBank #InstitutionalCrypto #BTC #ETH

DeFi protocols added roughly 20 billion in total value locked, and CryptoSlate's read on the number is unflattering: a big slice of it may be price inflation rather than fresh money.

Is crypto actually growing, or just getting more expensive?

Total value locked counts prices, not only deposits
TVL is the dollar value of every token parked inside a protocol's smart contracts. You get it by multiplying the number of tokens locked by what those tokens cost right now.

That's the trap CryptoSlate points at. A 20 billion jump can read as adoption while being mostly a revaluation of assets that were already sitting there. The way to separate the two is to watch token counts, not dollar figures.

translatedData.title: 200 million transactions, monthly active users down 30%: Where did Ethereum’s users go?
translatedData.subTitle:
ETH’s price is pretty steady, but on-chain data is strangely counterintuitive.
In Q2 2026, Ethereum L1 completed 203.9 million transactions, up 68.4% year over year, and throughput reached 25.9 TPS to set a new all-time high. Fees rose 31.6%, while the amount of ETH burned surged 112% quarter over quarter. The staking rate jumped to 32%, with nearly one-third of all ETH locked up.
But the strange part is: monthly active users actually fell 30%, down to 9.2 million.
More transactions, but fewer users. This means on-chain activity is concentrating among high-frequency whales, protocols, and bots. Retail is exiting, while institutions and programs take over.
Ethereum is shifting from a “public blockchain for ordinary people” to “the settlement layer.” The size of tokenized asset holdings is $203.1 billion, of which stablecoins account for $176.8 billion.

As of 15:00 (Beijing time) on September 16, Ethereum’s spot price is $2,400.67. Over the past 24 hours, it has fallen by about 2.7%, a decline that is more pronounced than Bitcoin’s. Volume-backed selling suggests that bearish forces are accelerating, but it may also imply that panic selling is nearing its end.

2. Technical Indicator Interpretation

The RSI has already moved deep into the oversold region. The 6-period RSI is down to 27.89, the 12-period RSI is 32.59, and the 24-period RSI is 35.62. A 6-period RSI breaking below 30 is a relatively strong oversold signal. Historically, ETH near this level has repeatedly seen technical rebounds. However, it’s important to note that during strong downtrends, RSI can remain oversold for extended periods.

The MACD indicates that bearish momentum is weakening at the margin. The DIFF line is at -20.64, the DEA line at -22.91, and the histogram value is 2.27. The KDJ indicator shows a rapid decline. The K value is down to 42.64, the D value is at 51.82, and the J value has fallen to 24.29. The William’s %R (WR) is at -87.22, which is extremely oversold. The metric has slid quickly from -46 to -87, reflecting the severity of panic selling in the short term. Taken together, multiple indicators suggest that ETH is in a technical oversold condition and rebound demand is building.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s current market environment is similar to Bitcoin’s, but the drawdown is larger, reflecting a more significant drop in market risk appetite toward altcoins. The failure of the CLARITY Act has a particularly direct impact on ETH. That bill was expected to provide a clear regulatory framework for digital assets, including ETH. 截至北京时间9月16日下午15时，以太坊现货报价2400.67美元，过去24小时内下跌约2.7%，跌幅明显大于比特币。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个交易小时内从2402美元逐步走弱至2387美元，最低触及2383美元，整体呈现弱势震荡下行的格局。

均线系统显示ETH处于明显的空头排列中。7周期均线报2401美元，25周期均线报2422美元，99周期均线高达2491美元。价格已经跌穿所有短中长期均线，且均线之间发散程度加大，表明下跌趋势仍在延续。布林带方面，上轨位于2441美元，中轨位于2408美元，下轨位于2375美元，价格正在逼近下轨，短期内若跌破2375美元则可能打开进一步下行空间。

成交量方面，最近两个小时的成交额分别达到2991万美元和2903万美元，较此前每小时的1200万至1400万美元水平放大了约一倍。放量下跌表明空方力量在加速释放，但同时也可能意味着恐慌性抛售接近尾声。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标已经深入超卖区域。RSI六周期数值降至27.89，RSI12周期为32.59，RSI24周期为35.62。六周期RSI跌破30是较为强烈的超卖信号，历史上ETH在该位置附近多次出现技术性反弹。不过需要注意的是，在强势下跌行情中，RSI可能在超卖区域持续较长时间。

MACD指标显示空头动能正在边际减弱。DIFF线报负20.64，DEA线报负22.91，柱状图值为2.27。虽然MACD仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图连续五个周期保持正值，显示下跌动能正在逐步衰减。不过最新柱状图值从2.93缩小至2.27，动能衰减的速度有所放缓。

KDJ指标出现了快速下行。K值降至42.64，D值位于51.82，J值跌至24.29。J值从此前91的高位快速回落，形成了明显的空头信号。不过J值已经进入超卖区域，后续可能出现低位金叉的反弹信号。

威廉指标WR报负87.22，已经极度超卖。该指标从负46快速下行至负87，反映了短期内恐慌性抛售的剧烈程度。综合多项指标来看，ETH已经处于技术性超卖状态，反弹需求正在积聚。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与比特币类似，但跌幅更大，反映出市场对-alt币的风险偏好下降更为显著。CLARITY法案的失败对ETH的影响尤为直接，因为该法案原本有望为包括ETH在内的数字资产提供明确的监管框架。法案的搁浅意味着SEC和CFTC的管辖权之争仍将持续，给ETH等主流-alt币带来了更大的不确定性。

美联储加息预期同样对ETH构成压力。十年期美债收益率突破5%，无风险利率的上升降低了持有零收益资产的机会成本，资金从风险资产向固定收益产品转移。此外，以太坊ETF在9月15日出现了1.423亿美元的净流出，鲸鱼账户的多头仓位也出现了强制平仓，进一步加剧了卖压。

不过从链上数据来看，Grayscale近期调整了投资组合配置，增加了对ETH相关产品的配置权重，表明机构对ETH的中长期前景仍抱有信心。短期内需要重点关注2380美元至2375美元区域的支撑力度，若能企稳则有望在2450美元附近展开反弹。

TVL is the dollar value of every token parked inside a protocol's smart contracts. You get it by multiplying the number of tokens locked by what those tokens cost right now.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构资金轮动下的价值重估机遇

2026年9月16日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间9月16日下午两点，以太坊报价2395美元，过去24小时下跌约3.1%。从小时K线来看，ETH在2393至2411美元区间内窄幅震荡，最新一根小时线收于2409美元附近。日内波动幅度约18美元，振幅不到0.8%，显示市场在经历前期大幅调整后进入短暂休整阶段。

以太坊近期的下跌主要受到宏观环境恶化的拖累。美国十年期国债收益率突破5%大关，创下2007年以来新高，直接提升了无风险资产的吸引力，对以太坊等风险资产形成压制。叠加CLARITY法案在参议院闯关失败，加密市场整体承压，ETH一度跌至2390美元附近的九月低点。

不过，从链上数据和机构动向来看，以太坊的基本面正在发生积极变化。Grayscale在其面向财务顾问的下一代模型组合中将以太坊的配置比例设定为42.34%，远超其他加密资产，彰显了机构对以太坊生态系统的长期信心。更值得关注的是，一位大型鲸鱼近期将价值超过6500万美元的包装比特币兑换为26924枚以太坊，这一大规模资产轮动表明聪明钱正在从比特币向以太坊转移。

交易所余额方面，以太坊流通量持续下降，交易所持仓降至606万枚，为近年来低位。大量以太坊被锁定在质押池、自托管钱包和ETF产品中，市场可流通供应的减少为价格提供了坚实的底部支撑。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统显示以太坊仍处于空头格局。当前价格略低于7日均线2403美元，明显低于25日均线2426美元和99日均线2492美元。三条均线呈典型空头排列，且间距仍在扩大，表明中长期下行趋势尚未结束。不过7日均线已趋于走平，短期下跌动能有所减弱。

MACD指标方面，MACD线为负19.56，信号线为负23.28，柱状图为正值3.72且连续五个周期放大。虽然MACD线仍在零轴下方，但柱状图的持续放大表明空方动能正在衰减，多方力量逐步积聚。若柱状图继续保持放大态势，MACD线有望在未来数个周期内上穿信号线形成金叉。

RSI指标呈现中性偏强态势。6周期RSI回升至52.84，已回到50中轴上方；12周期RSI为41.56，24周期RSI为39.82，仍处于偏弱区间。短中长期RSI的分化表明市场处于短期反弹但中期趋势未明的过渡阶段。

KDJ指标显示K值为73.88，D值为62.01，J值为97.61。J值接近100的超买区域，暗示短期反弹可能面临技术性回调压力。布林带方面，价格运行于中轨2413美元下方，上轨2456美元构成阻力，下轨2370美元提供支撑。带宽收窄趋势明显，预示变盘在即。

综合信号指标给出做多信号，胜率约为71.4%。但需要注意的是，因子统计显示空方因子数量略多于多方因子，市场方向尚未完全明朗。价格需要有效突破2430美元才能确认短期反弹趋势。

三、市场情绪分析

💡 Bearish point 📉：Regulatory implementation is still a long way off, and short-term sentiment remains under pressure.

According to Crypto Briefing, the U.S. Senate rejected the CLARITY Act, and Bitcoin immediately sank more than 5%, now trading at $75,882.01 (24h -2.02%).

One sentence to make it clear
The regulatory framework bill the crypto market is most hoping for was blocked—so the short-term bearish shock hits the price directly.

What happened
The CLARITY Act is the most anticipated piece of legislation in this bull market—its core is to clarify what the SEC and CFTC each regulate, and give tokens a clear classification. But the Senate blocked it right away. In plain terms, the market had been pricing “regulatory implementation” as part of the equation; now that expectation has been removed, the first reaction from capital is to withdraw.

BTC fell 2.02% in 24 hours to $75,882.01, ETH dropped 3.68% to $2,397.21, and XRP fell the most, down 7.81%—because it has the highest beta to regulatory news, which isn’t surprising.

One-sentence translation: It’s not that the coin has a problem—the answer to “when will the problem be solved?” has been delayed again.

Market impact
- Short term：Bearish on sentiment, and regulatory uncertainty is repriced again. Coins like XRP, which rely heavily on regulatory narratives, will face noticeably more pressure than BTC. Capital will most likely continue to rotate toward BTC and stablecoins for safety.
- Medium term：The act being blocked doesn’t mean it’s dead. It will likely be pushed again after clause-by-clause wrangling. But the longer legislative timeline means the “compliance-favorable” rally for altcoins will have to wait a bit longer.

My take
Bearish in the short term. BTC is watching support around $75,882.01—if it breaks, it could dip toward prior lows. $75,882.01 above is a rebound resistance. ETH is relatively weaker; if $2,397.21 doesn’t hold, the risk of further downside after a move lower is significant. My own view is that within 12 hours, sentiment will keep digesting the bearish news; after a sharp selloff, there could be a rebound, but trend repair depends on the market repricing based on renewed regulatory developments. I’m 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% is left to the market. Even on positioning, I’m only taking a small-risk approach.

一句话说清楚
加密市场最期待的监管框架法案被拦，短期利空直接砸在价格上。

怎么回事
CLARITY法案是本轮牛市里市场最寄予厚望的立法——核心是厘清SEC和CFTC各自管什么，给代币一个明确的身份认定。结果参议院直接把它拦下来了。说白了，市场之前把“监管落地”当成了定价因素的一部分，现在这个预期被打掉，资金第一反应就是撤。BTC 24小时跌2.02%报$75,882.01，ETH跌3.68%报$2,397.21，XRP最惨跌7.81%——它对监管新闻的beta最高，这点不意外。

一句话翻译：不是币出了问题，是“问题什么时候解决”这个答案又被推迟了。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪面利空，监管不确定性重新计价。XRP这类高度依赖监管叙事的币承压会明显大于BTC，资金大概率继续往BTC和稳定币避险。
- 中期：法案被拦不等于法案死了，大概率是条款拉扯后重新推进。但立法周期拉长，意味着山寨币的“合规春风”行情要再等等。

我的判断
短期偏空。BTC关注$75,882.01一线支撑，跌破可能下探前低；上方$75,882.01是反弹阻力。ETH相对更弱，$2,397.21不保的话补跌风险不小。我自己的判断是12小时内情绪还会继续消化利空，急跌之后可能有反抽，但趋势修复得等监管消息面的重新定价。这个判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场，仓位上也只是小仓位应对。

Barclays, however, kept the $160 target at this moment. Even more worth pondering is the grouping logic: putting MSTR alongside Visa and Mastercard implies the bank already treats a “crypto-held treasury company” as a type of financial infrastructure business that can be priced—not as a speculative shell. 2.06 million XRP moved from Uphold to short-side liquidation—was it a giant whale running away, or just moving house?

Uphold wallet 145.6 million XRP transferred out; on-chain evidence shows it was internal rebalancing, not a sell-off.

💡 Impact assessment: Neutral to bullish—don’t be scared by a “whale escape” headline.

What happened
According to Bitcoin.com, on September 14, on-chain monitoring captured a transfer of 145,634,500 XRP (about $206,551,114). It directly emptied a wallet marked as an exchange wallet for Uphold. The moment the alert went off, the community exploded: “A whale is about to dump.” But after digging into the on-chain records, you’ll find the receiving party is also linked to the Uphold system. The funds didn’t flow to an unknown address, and there’s no evidence of trading/spot-selling deposits into an exchange.

In plain terms, this is routine housekeeping of an exchange custody wallet—consolidating scattered hot wallets into a main wallet. It’s the same script as those “Bitfinex cold wallet anomalies” back in 2019.

One-sentence translation: The money changed pockets, but not owners—and definitely not into sell orders.

Market impact
- Short term: The emotional shock is bigger than the actual impact. XRP is down 7.66% over the past 24 hours (current price $1.298). It’s already in a broad sell-off environment—BTC is down 1.95% to $75,955, and ETH is down 3.39% to $2,406. These “massive transfer” alerts often get amplified into panic narratives in a weak market, but if $206.55 million truly meant to be dumped, on-chain exchange-deposit records should have appeared by now—there aren’t any.
- Medium term: No effect. Internal rebalancing within an exchange is standard operating procedure and doesn’t change XRP’s supply-demand structure. What truly determines the medium-term direction is the broader market’s risk appetite, not this transfer.

My take
I’m watching, and I don’t see this as a bearish signal. Today’s XRP (-7.66%) is the hardest-hit mainstream coin in the market. It’s clearly catch-up selling plus a weak-market correlation—not something caused by a transfer dump. If XRP can stabilize around $1.29, the panic narrative will fade on its own; otherwise, if the broader market keeps weakening, XRP’s downside volatility will likely be even larger.

I’m 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% I’ll leave to the broader market. If I’m wrong, go easy on me—I’m only observing with a small position and haven’t moved.

💡 影响判断：中性偏多，别被“巨鲸出逃”的标题吓到。

怎么回事
据 Bitcoin.com，9月14日链上监控抓到一笔145,634,500枚XRP的转账，价值约2.06亿美元（精确值$206,551,114），直接把一个标记为Uphold的交易所钱包清空。警报一响，社群立刻炸锅：“巨鲸砸盘前兆”。但扒了链上记录后会发现：收款方同样关联Uphold体系，资金没有流向未知地址，也没有进交易所卖盘。说白了，这就是交易所例行的托管钱包整理，把零散热钱包归拢到主钱包，跟2019年那些“Bitfinex冷钱包异动”是同款剧本。

一句话翻译：钱换了口袋，但没换主人，更没换成卖单。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪冲击大于实际冲击。XRP 24小时已经跌了7.66%（现价$1.298），本身处于普跌行情——BTC $75,955跌1.95%、ETH $2,406跌3.39%。这类“巨额转账”警报容易在弱市里被放大成恐慌叙事，但2.06亿美元如果真要砸，链上早该看到进所记录，目前没有。
- 中期：零影响。交易所内部调仓是运营常态，不改变XRP的供需结构。真正决定中期方向的是大盘风险偏好，不是这笔转账。

我的判断
观望，不把这当利空。XRP今天-7.66%是全场跌得最狠的主流币，明显是补跌+弱市共振，不是转账砸出来的。$1.29附近若能企稳，恐慌叙事会自己消散；反之若大盘继续走弱，XRP的跌幅弹性也会更大。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给大盘。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位观察，没动。

In a range market, the tolerance for chasing or cutting is lower; it’s more suitable to use upper-bound confirmation to follow direction and lower-bound confirmation for support holding, with the midline only serving as the strength/weakness divider.

The three price points that need to be tracked together are: the midline 2,403.94, the upper confirmation level 2,449, and the lower defensive level 2,358.88. The midline determines short-term initiative, while the upper and lower boundaries determine whether the market truly breaks away from the original trading range.

My scenario analysis isn’t a single-direction bet. If price breaks above 2,449 and can hold, it means the upside space has been reopened; if it falls below 2,358.88 and cannot retest successfully, it indicates the structure is weakening further. If it trades between the two, then continue to observe the closing behavior on both sides of 2,403.94.

For those who already hold positions, the key is to manage based on whether support fails, not to be carried away by every fluctuation. For those who are flat, prioritize waiting for a breakout with a pullback or for support confirmation. For spot positions, you can scale in batches; for futures/derivatives, shorten the decision chain—first determine the stop-loss level, then decide whether to participate.

A trading plan must include invalidation conditions. Even if your judgment is correct, you can realize gains in stages; if your judgment is wrong, you must be allowed to exit. title: ⚠️ AVISO IMPORTANTE 🚨
subTitle:
A CoinEx confirmou oficialmente o encerramento total e definitivo de suas operações globais. A decisão, anunciada pelo fundador e CEO Haipo Yang, marca o fim de uma trajetória de 9 anos no mercado de criptoativos. Segundo o comunicado, o fechamento foi motivado por uma combinação de retração prolongada do mercado (inverno cripto), queda severa nos volumes de negociação e custos regulatórios e de conformidade que "ultrapassaram os limites razoáveis.

Para evitar prejuízos aos usuários, a corretora afirmou que mantém reservas superiores a 100% e iniciou um processo de desmobilização gradual e ordenado.

🗓️ Cronograma de Desligamento da CoinEx

O processo de encerramento acontecerá em fases para que os clientes retirem seus fundos com segurança:

15 de setembro de 2026 (Início): Novos cadastros foram bloqueados, mercados de futuros entraram em modo de "Apenas Redução" (fechamento de posições) e novos empréstimos ou produtos de rendimento foram suspensos.

22 de setembro de 2026: Todos os serviços que não sejam de negociação à vista (mercado spot) serão permanentemente encerrados e os depósitos na blockchain (on-chain) serão bloqueados.

29 de setembro de 2026: Fim definitivo de todas as negociações à vista (spot). As criptomoedas remanescentes na conta que não forem USDT serão automaticamente convertidas pela plataforma para a stablecoin USDT.

22 de dezembro de 2026: Data limite regulamentar para saques. O suporte a retiradas da plataforma será encerrado permanentemente às 02:00 UTC. Ativos deixados após essa data serão movidos para uma custódia independente sujeita a taxas

⚠️ Atenção com a Recompra do Token CET

Se você possui o token nativo da plataforma, o CoinEx Token (CET), a exchange informou que realizará uma recompra compulsória de todas as unidades por um preço fixo de 0,005 USDT por CET entre os dias 15 e 29 de setembro de 2026, sem limites de quantidade. Após o dia 29 de setembro, as moedas CET restantes nas carteiras serão convertidas automaticamente para USDT sob a mesma cotação.

💡 Nota de segurança: Durante este período de encerramento, golpistas costumam criar sites falsos de suporte. Certifique-se de acessar apenas o Site Oficial da CoinEx e nunca forneça suas chaves privadas ou senhas para "desbloquear" saques. Os serviços independentes CoinEx Wallet e CoinEx Vault não fazem parte da exchange e continuarão operando

Ethereum is not only a cryptocurrency asset, but also critical infrastructure for DeFi, stablecoins, staking, and on-chain finance. subTitle:
正文

今天加密市场出现明显回落。
BTC一度跌破 76,000 美元，ETH同步走弱。
这次下跌有两个直接催化：
① 美国参议院未能推进 CLARITY Act

② 市场正在等待今晚的美联储利率决定
但如果只盯着新闻，很容易被短期波动带着走。
从走势结构来看，我现在更关注3个位置：
第一：74,000～75,000
这是目前下方比较重要的防守区域。
如果价格在这里出现明显承接，说明空头力量暂时没有进一步扩张。
第二：76,500～78,000
这里已经从原来的支撑区域逐渐转变成短线需要重新突破的压力区域。
如果BTC重新站回并稳定在这个区域上方，结构才有机会重新修复。
第三：不要因为一根大阴线直接改变自己的交易系统。
我做低频交易，最重要的一条原则就是：
价格波动 ≠ 结构确认。
消息可以让价格快速移动，
但最终还是要回到走势本身。
所以今晚我不会提前猜美联储之后BTC一定涨还是一定跌。
我只等市场把结构走出来。
看得懂的时候再做，看不懂的时候就等。
这也是我一直坚持的：
不预测，做跟随。
— 龙小雨
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Перспективы Ethereum фундаментально сильнее, чем у большинства альткоинов, благодаря следующим факторам:
Дефляционная модель (PoS): После перехода на алгоритм Proof-of-Stake и внедрения механизма сжигания комиссий (EIP-1559), высокая активность в сети приводит к сокращению общего предложения $ETH , что толкает цену вверх при стабильном спросе
Развитие сетей 2-го уровня (L2): Масштабирование через экосистемы Arbitrum, Optimism и Base снижает комиссии для конечных пользователей, сохраняя при этом Ethereum в качестве главного расчетного уровня (Settlement Layer)
Институциональный интерес: Торгуемые на бирже фонды (ETF) на базе Ethereum открывают доступ к активу крупному традиционному капиталу, что обеспечивает долгосрочную ликвидность.

Криптовалютный рынок сопряжен с высокими рисками, и инвестиции в ETH могут привести к потере капитала в случае реализации негативных сценариев:
Регуляторное давление: Попытки контролирующих органов (например, SEC в США) классифицировать ETH или стейкинг как незарегистрированные ценные бумаги могут вызвать панику на рынке.Конкуренция: Быстрые и дешевые блокчейны 1-го уровня (например, Solana) продолжают бороться за долю рынка децентрализованных приложений (dApps) и DeFi.Макроэкономические факторы: Повышение процентных ставок мировыми центробанками или рецессия традиционно снижают интерес инвесторов к высокорисковым активам, включая криптовалюту.#EthereumFallsBelow$2400

translatedData.title: Leveraged longs swept out about $570 million in a day: the leverage bill after CLARITY failed
translatedData.subTitle:
When the legislative narrative retreats, the leveraged longs are the ones that get bought first.

CoinDesk cites CoinGlass: about 24 hours after the Senate CLARITY procedural vote failed to clear the 60-vote threshold, exchanges liquidated long positions worth about $571 million— the highest since August 22; on the shorts side, it’s only about $100 million.

The structure is very clear: $BTC, $ETH —each long position is about 190 million; XRP is about 30 million, and SOL about 22 million. Previously, the market wrote into its positions that the “bill could move forward.” On Monday, $BTC  it briefly lifted from roughly 77,000 to nearly 80,000. The narrative hit a snag—leverage was squeezed out first.

My view: what’s worth watching isn’t “how much it fell,” but the position structure—longs were liquidated far more than shorts, suggesting consensus is overly optimistic. CoinDesk wrote that $BTC  it is still within its recent range, around 75,700: volatility has been amplified, but it hasn’t broken out of the range yet.

Tonight the Fed will announce its rate decision. Friends in Bitcoin and Ethereum, focus on two key times:
At 2:00 a.m. Beijing time on September 17, the interest rate decision and the dot plot will be released, and at 2:30 a.m. the Fed Chair will hold a press conference. Don’t wait until 2:30 to start watching— the first round of volatility may come as early as 2:00.
Right now, the market mainly expects a 25-basis-point hike, i.e., 0.25 percentage points. But the more critical question tonight is: after this hike, how much more is still planned?
I’m watching three things closely:
① The size of the rate hike. 25 bps is the mainstream expectation; only if the increase is larger will it mean an additional tightening shock.
② The dot plot. It shows officials’ forecasts for future rates. Look at what level they expect the rate to be by the end of this year and next year. If the forecast is higher than the market expects, it suggests high-rate pressure may last longer; but the dot plot is not a policy commitment.
③ The 2:30 a.m. remarks. Is the Chair emphasizing that inflation still needs to be kept under pressure, or is it a signal to observe after this hike? This will affect the market’s judgment on subsequent hikes, and could also change the market direction after 2:00.
My view: if the hike matches expectations and the remarks aren’t too hawkish, crypto may see a rebound after “bad news is priced in.” If the dot plot and the remarks are more hawkish than expected, Bitcoin and Ethereum could face continued pressure.
So, a higher probability of a rate hike doesn’t automatically mean the coin price must fall. Tonight I’ll look at Fed Treasury yields, the U.S. dollar, and coin prices together—especially whether the first wave of up/down movement after the press conference can carry on. Control your position size, and don’t treat the first spike as the final direction.
#利率会议 #ETH

Let’s talk about #BTC  and #ETH  and the next round of adjustments—I'll map out the bearish targets I’m watching.

First, look at #ETH . It’s still in the Q3 rebound phase, with the price rebounding back to around 2300.

Once the Q4 downtrend officially kicks in, levels like 2200, 2100, and 2k will be hard to hold against selling pressure—especially the 2000 psychological integer level. It’s highly likely it will be broken through directly.

Once the downward trend fully emerges, psychological integer marks won’t provide real protection. After 2k is broken, 1900 and 1800 will likely fall one after another. For the first stop, I’m looking at 1700. However, I don’t think 1700 can hold either. If it can’t maintain support here, the market will likely turn back to test the previous low from June this year (1505)—and that low also has the possibility of being breached.

After 1505 is lost, 1400 and 1300 won’t stop sell orders either. The key bottom range for this round of adjustment, in my view, is 1250–1280.

Entering Q4 won’t just mean technical deterioration—it will also bring multiple pressures, such as institutions reducing positions, a chain of leverage liquidations, and year-end capital returning. Many of the sell-offs are forced stops from liquidations rather than subjective selling. So this ETH correction won’t simply end at 2k, 1800, or 1700.

Now, take #BTC . Its overall performance is even weaker than ETH. At the moment, it’s still in the Q3 rebound cycle, with the price rebounding to around 75k. When the down cycle begins, 70k will likely break first, followed by a drop to 60k, and then a test of 58k. Even the key integer level of 50k won’t hold.

In the move where BTC was pushed up from 40k to 60k, the exchange of positions wasn’t thorough. The 40k–60k range itself never formed solid, sustained support. Once 58k is smashed, the coin price will move quickly downward to find real support.

For this adjustment, the first key bottom range is 45k–48k. I think it’s very likely it will be reached. If conditions deteriorate further—if institutional liquidation and tightening liquidity continue to intensify—then the extreme bottom would be 35k–38k. Below that, I won’t make predictions.

To quickly outline the BTC bearish path for this round: break below 70k → break below 60k → punch through 58k → lose 50k. The first bottom is 45k–48k, and the extreme limit is 35k–38k.

A genuine correction won’t rely on psychological integer levels to mark the bottom. As long as the downtrend hasn’t ended, support levels will be broken layer by layer.

content:
聊聊 #BTC  和 #ETH  接下来这一轮调整，梳理下我看的下跌目标。

先看 #ETH ，目前还处在 Q3 的反弹行情，价格回升到 2300 附近。

一旦 Q4 的下跌行情正式启动，2200、2100、2k 这些位置很难扛住抛压，尤其是 2000 这个大家关注的整数关口，很大概率会直接被跌穿。

下跌趋势一旦彻底走出来，心理上的整数位起不到防护作用。跌破 2k 之后，1900、1800 也会相继失守，第一站先看向 1700。不过我并不认为 1700 就能稳住行情，如果这里撑不住，就会回头去测试今年 6 月 1505 的前期低点，而且这个低点同样存在被击穿的可能。

1505 失守之后，1400、1300 也挡不住卖盘，这一轮调整真正的关键底部区间我看在1250‑1280。 

进入 Q4 不光是技术面走坏，还会叠加机构减仓、杠杆连环清算、年底资金回笼等多重压力，不少抛盘是被动止损出来的，不是主观卖出。所以 ETH 这波调整，不会简简单单在 2k、1800 或者 1700 就结束。

再看 #BTC ，整体表现比 ETH 还要弱一些。 现阶段还在 Q3 反弹周期，价格反弹至 75k 附近。等到下跌周期开启，7 万会率先跌破，随后下探 6 万，接着考验 58k，而 5 万这个重要整数关口同样守不住。

之前 BTC 从 4 万拉升到 6 万的这一段，筹码交换并不充分，4 万‑6 万区间本身就没有沉淀出扎实的支撑。一旦 58k 被砸破，币价会快速向下寻找真实支撑。 

本轮调整第一个重点底部区间4.5 万‑4.8 万，这个位置我认为很大概率会见到。 如果后续市场进一步恶化，机构清算、流动性收紧继续发酵，那极限底部看3.5 万‑3.8 万，再往下我就不做预判了。

简单捋一遍 BTC 下跌路径：跌破 7 万→下破 6 万→击穿 5.8 万→失守 5 万，第一底部 4.5‑4.8 万，极端极限 3.5‑3.8 万。

真正的调整行情，不会依靠整数心理关口来见底。只要下跌趋势没有终结，各个支撑位就会被一层一层击穿。

🔥 I. The rate decision lands—why BTC may not necessarily crash

Many people think that Fed rate hikes are bearish, so Bitcoin must fall. But the market is never that simple.

Rate hikes usually mean higher funding costs, stronger appeal of the USD and U.S. Treasuries, and potential selling pressure on risk assets.

However, if the market has already priced in the rate-hike expectations in advance, then after the decision is announced, you may actually see a rebound as the “bad news” is fully digested.

📈 Bull case: bad news fully digested, funds return. If BTC holds key support and then breaks back above the overhead resistance zone, the market could see a round of short-covering rallies.

📉 Bear case: hawkish signals trigger selling. If the Fed releases signals of maintaining high rates for a longer period, with the USD and U.S. Treasury yields continuing to strengthen, BTC could face renewed pressure.

What really matters is not the immediate spike or drop at the announcement, but whether the trend can continue!

#FedRateWatch  What's the Fed's Next Move?

90% of traders are expecting this hike... but the real question is  is this just a one-off, or the start of a whole cycle? 👀

August core CPI came in at +0.3% month-over-month, still running above the Fed's 2% target, and futures markets are now pricing in close to a 90%+ chance of a 25bp hike at this week's meeting  the first hike since 2023. My read: this looks less like a one-off and more like the Fed signaling it's not done fighting inflation. If the dot plot released alongside the decision shows more than one hike penciled in for the next few quarters, that's the tell it's the start of a cycle, not a single adjustment.

If the hike lands as expected, I'd expect a mixed reaction across assets. $BTC  and risk assets could see a short-term dip as higher rates pressure liquidity and raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets though a "hike priced in" outcome sometimes triggers relief buying instead, especially if the tone on future hikes is cautious. Tech stocks are the most rate-sensitive of the bunch; higher discount rates compress valuations on long-duration growth names first. Gold is trickier  a hawkish Fed with a stronger dollar tends to weigh on it short term, but if the hike is framed as inflation-fighting rather than growth-supportive, gold can hold up better than usual as a hedge.

My plan 1 : trimming tech exposure into the decision, keeping BTC core position unhedged, watching gold for a dip-buy if DXY spikes.

My plan 2 : staying on the sidelines for this one  no active trades right now. Watching how BTC, tech and gold react post-decision before deciding my next move

Not financial advice  just how I'm thinking about positioning into Wednesday's decision. Curious how others are playing it.

#FedRateWatch #BTC

September 16, $BTC  (early morning) analysis
Key points of the interest rate decision: hold steady, but the signals are strongly hawkish
The Federal Reserve will release its interest rate decision at 2:00 a.m. Beijing time on September 17. The Federal Open Market Committee voted 11 to 1 to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at the 3.50%-3.75% range. This is the fourth time this year the Fed has chosen to hold steady.
The median forecast for the federal funds rate at the end of 2026 was revised sharply upward from 3.4% at the March meeting to 3.8%. Out of 18 officials, 9 expect at least one additional rate hike within the year. The latest statement from the interest rate decision clearly notes that inflation relative to the 2% target is “still elevated,” partly due to supply shocks in specific areas such as energy.
The major deviation from market expectations is the core of this round of volatility: earlier, FedWatch showed the market priced a September rate hike probability as high as 92.7%, and the probability of another hike in December at nearly 50%. Although the dot plot suggests only one hike this year, the degree of hawkishness—9 officials supporting hikes, with the median revised up to 3.8%—creates a stark expectation gap compared with some institutions’ earlier expectations of a “neutral-to-dovish” stance. The Fed has just raised interest rates by 25 basis points, bringing the federal funds rate range to 3.75%–4%. This is a notable shift for the crypto market, because interest rates and liquidity often have a major impact on investors’ risk appetite. 

What’s especially worth noting right now isn’t only that the Fed raised rates, but how much information the market has already priced in before this decision.

For $BTC, I’m watching 3 factors:

🔹 1. Reaction to the news:
If BTC can hold a key support zone after the market digests the Fed decision, selling pressure may gradually ease.

🔹 2. Liquidity:
After the sharp moves around the FOMC, it can sometimes be more important for BTC to consolidate sideways and accumulate than to immediately pump.

🔹 3. Altcoins:
If BTC stabilizes, fresh capital may start flowing into ETH and certain altcoins with strong liquidity. Conversely, if BTC loses support, altcoins typically experience even stronger volatility.

👉 So instead of chasing FOMO right after the Fed news, I’ll watch the volume + BTC’s reaction at prior support/resistance zones before making a decision.

title: 币圈玄学周报｜9月17日：FOMC加息落地，“甲午日忌开市”已应验，空头47.9亿的燃料堆在上方
subTitle:
⚠️ 本文纯属娱乐，不构成任何投资建议。玄学分析仅供下饭，别拿它梭哈。

一、先看看今天的基本盘

今天是2026年9月17日，星期四。

昨天我们说“成日先难后易，FOMC才是真正的哨响”。今天凌晨2:00，哨声响了。美联储宣布加息25个基点，将联邦基金利率目标区间上调至3.75%-4.00%，12票全票通过。这是美联储自2023年7月以来首次加息，也是沃什担任主席后的第一次加息。

BTC的反应堪称教科书级—— 决议公布后一小时内急速下探至75355美元，随后迅速回升至76000上方。截至发稿，#BTC 报约76017美元，24小时微涨0.26%。#ETH 报2410美元，24小时基本持平。#SOL 涨0.86%至98.37美元，#XRP 微跌0.10%至1.30美元。
{spot}(BTCUSDT)
恐慌贪婪指数从昨天的51降至50，正式站上“中性”线。注意这个数字——50是贪婪与恐慌的分界点，多空双方在此处力量均衡，谁也没赢。

爆仓数据：过去24小时全网爆仓3.46亿美元，其中空单爆仓1.96亿美元，多单爆仓1.5亿美元。BTC空单爆仓5363万美元，多单爆仓3217万美元；ETH空单爆仓4475万美元，多单爆仓4221万美元。

空头比多头死得更多。 这是今天盘面最重要的一句话。

二、今天的核心事件：鹰派加息，但市场没崩

先说FOMC的细节。

加息25个基点，12:0全票通过。 声明非常简洁，删除了此前版本中将高通胀归因于“供给冲击”的表述，反映出委员们认为物价压力扩散范围已经过于广泛。

沃什在发布会上说得很直白： “通胀仍然处于高位。今天的政策行动，将帮助通胀更快回到委员会2%的目标。当前经济韧性很强，消费、资本开支、劳动力市场都表现稳健，能够承受本次收紧。” 

点阵图更值得注意：19名委员中12人预计年内还将再加息一次，2026年利率中值从6月的预测上修30个基点至4.1%。经济预测方面，核心PCE增速上修至3.4%，预计到2029年才能回到2%目标，比此前预估晚一年。

特朗普在Truth Social上发文称“我们应当拥有全球最低的利率” ，但沃什用全票通过加息直接回应了这份压力。

核心问题来了：这么鹰的决议，为什么BTC没崩？

两个原因。

第一，利空出尽。 交易员此前押注9月加息概率已超过90%，绝大部分卖压发生在决议之前。BTC从8月的高点82000一路跌到75000附近，跌幅近9%，已经提前消化了加息预期。决议落地后，没有新增利空，反而给了多头喘息空间。

第二，空头踩踏。 昨天CLARITY法案折戟后，大量交易者加码做空。过去24小时的数据显示，空头清算额是多头的1.3倍。在75355砸出低点后，空头平仓盘成了反弹的第一推动力。

三、玄学时间：甲午日“忌开市”，黄历又提前写好了剧本

查一下今天的黄历：

2026年9月17日，农历八月初七，丙午年丁酉月甲午日，收执位。五行：砂石金。

彭祖百忌：“甲不开仓财物耗散，午不苫盖屋主更张。” 

翻译一下：甲日不宜开仓动用库存，恐财物耗损散失；午日不宜苫盖屋顶，恐屋主日后变故翻修。

黄历宜：嫁娶、祭祀、理发、进人口、作灶、会亲友。忌：开仓、出货财、开市、上梁、盖屋、破土。

“忌开市”三个字，今天再次精准应验。

凌晨FOMC公布加息，#BTC从76000上方砸到75355——这不就是“甲不开仓，财物耗散”吗？如果你在决议之前重仓押注方向，那一小时就是你的“财物耗散”时刻。

但注意，“收日”在十二建星里排在第十，含义是 “收获、收成、功德圆满” 。今天的盘面就是“先开仓散财，后收成回稳”——跌下去的那一截被收回来了，BTC重新站稳76000。

吉神方面，今日有月空、不将、福生、金匮、鸣犬五路吉神加持。凶神有大时、大败、咸池、天贼、九坎、九焦。

“天贼”主盗窃损失，对应凌晨那波急跌——“天贼”趁FOMC的混乱偷走了一批多头的止损。“金匮”主财帛收藏，对应随后的反弹——“金匮”把跌下去的价格又收了回来。

冲煞方面，今日冲鼠（戊子）煞北。如果你在家盯盘，今天别面朝正北。
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
四、比特币的八字走到哪一步了？

今天日柱甲午。甲为阳木，午为阳火。木生火，火势极旺。

结合年柱丙午、月柱丁酉来看，今天的格局是：丙午年的火 + 丁酉月的金 + 甲午日的木火。

木生火，火克金。今天的“火”是三重叠加——年火、月火、日火。金（酉月）被三重火烧灼，对水属性的加密资产来说，短期的“蒸腾”压力是巨大的。

但关键在于秋分。

秋分在9月23日08:04到来。秋分之后，太阳进入天秤座，金气进入全年最旺的阶段。今天的甲午日是秋分前倒数第二个交易日，正处于“火气最后挣扎”的窗口。

从五行角度看，今天的急跌—反弹—企稳，就是“火克金”到“金反制火”的转折点雏形。75355这个低点，有可能就是秋分前的最低点候选。

五、天王星逆行第7天：混乱峰值已过，真相开始浮出水面

天王星在双子座逆行已进入第7天。9月11日开始的这轮逆行，混乱能量在9月16日前后达到峰值。今天是第7天，峰值已过，能量开始回落。

昨天我们说“天王星逆行遇上法案投票日，信息噪音达到峰值”。今天回头看，三个事件在48小时内连环引爆：CLARITY法案折戟、FOMC鹰派加息、BTC从77000砸到75355再反弹回76000。

每一件单独拿出来都是重磅，但三件事叠在一起，市场反而没有崩溃。

这就是天王星逆行的能量特征——当信息过载到一定程度，市场会进入“麻木状态”，不再对单条消息做出剧烈反应，而是等待所有噪音沉淀后再选择方向。

水星在处女座入庙，处女座的分析能量正在发挥作用：投资者不再被单一消息驱动，而是开始综合评估——CLARITY没通过是利空，FOMC加息是利空，但BTC从82000跌到75000已经跌了将近9%，这些利空是否已经充分定价？

处女座在逼所有人算账。算完账再决定方向。
{spot}(SOLUSDT)
六、重点看一个东西：空头堆了47.9亿美元的燃料

今天最值得关注的不是价格，是清算地图。

CoinGlass数据显示，在75982美元至83575美元区间，累计空头清算压力高达47.9亿美元，而下方至67861美元区间的多头清算规模仅为20.5亿美元。空头清算压力是下方的2.5倍。

这意味着什么？

如果BTC从这里开始反弹，进入76000-83500区间，将触发大规模空头回补。 被动买盘可能引发连锁反应，形成一轮“空头挤压”。

但反过来，如果BTC跌破75000继续下行，下方多头清算规模只有20.5亿，“燃料”远远不够支撑一次像样的反弹。

盘面结构极度不对称：上方堆满了空头尸体，下方一片空旷。

这不是一个“继续看跌”的结构。这是一个“空头拥挤” 的结构。而历史上，当空头拥挤到这种程度，往往意味着反向行情随时可能引爆。

七、以太坊的“气”走到了哪一步？

ETH今天报2410美元，24小时基本持平。盘中有个有趣的链上信号：某地址于凌晨1:35从Coinbase提出4827枚#ETH ，价值1152万美元，提出时ETH价格为2416美元。随后ETH最低跌至2358.88美元，该仓位一度亏损27.6万美元，但随币价反弹已回到水上。

这个地址的操作非常有代表性——在FOMC最恐慌的时刻从交易所提币，说明有资金在“别人恐慌时贪婪”。

从五行角度看，ETH更接近“木”的属性。在丁酉金月中，金克木，但今日甲午日木火透干，木得火助，反而有“克中求生”的动能。ETH的短期弹性可能大于BTC，但前提是BTC先稳住。

八、玄学操作节奏（仅供娱乐）

今天9月17日（甲午日，收日）：已应验“忌开市→先散后收”。 凌晨的急跌是“甲不开仓”，随后的反弹是“金匮收财”。接下来的时间，玄学建议：观察76000能否站稳。 如果欧盘时段BTC能守住76000上方，说明“收日”的成色不错。

9月18日-19日：秋分前最后的蓄力窗口。 黄历上这两天进入“白露”节气的尾声。从五行角度看，火气在秋分前最后挣扎，价格可能在75500-77500之间反复震荡。如果出现二次探底不破75355，那是“金气”开始接管的信号。

9月23日秋分：金气最旺的窗口正式开启。 从五行角度，秋分后金气达到全年峰值，对水属性的加密资产形成最有力的支撑。如果FOMC的利空已经被市场充分消化（从今天的反弹来看大概率是），秋分后的#BTC 有望重新挑战78000-80000区间。

空头挤压预警：如果BTC在秋分后突然放量突破78000，不要惊讶——那是47.9亿美元空头清算压力被点燃的结果。

风水方位提醒：今日冲鼠煞北，别面朝正北。财神位在东北，喜神位在东北，福神位在正北——但今日“甲不开仓”，财神也不太管事。今天最该待的方位还是“不动”。

穿衣玄学：今天大吉色是红色、橙色（五行属火，与今日五行相同）。次吉色是黄色、米色（五行属土，土生金，金生水）。不宜穿黑色、蓝色（五行属水，今日火旺，水被蒸腾）。

九、最后说句人话

今天的关键词是五个字：利空出尽？

CLARITY法案折戟、FOMC鹰派加息——两个重磅利空在48小时内接连落地。BTC从82000跌到75355，跌幅近9%。所有的坏消息都摆在桌上了。

但今天的盘面告诉我们：没有进一步的恐慌性抛售。

BTC在75355触底后反弹回76000。恐慌贪婪指数稳在50。空头比多头死得更多。

甲午日说：忌开市，但收日功德圆满。
点阵图说：年内还可能再加一次息。
清算地图说：上方47.9亿空头等着被烧。

三套系统指向一个可能的结论：利空正在出尽，但反转还需要一个催化剂。

那个催化剂，大概率在秋分之后。

⚠️ 再次声明：以上内容纯属娱乐创作，所有玄学分析均不构成投资建议。加密市场波动剧烈，请根据自身风险承受能力独立决策。玄学可以看，但别当真。

title: 刚出炉：Fed升息落地，$BTC守住7.65万
subTitle:
一、发生了什么

几分钟前的早盘盘面并不躁。

比特币守在7.63万至7.65万美元一带,关键观察位是7.65万;$ETH回到2418美元附近,最新参考价2428.48美元,24小时上涨1.40%。

Fed 9月升息1码已经落地,市场没有恐慌抛售,也没有暴力拉升。

10点这个节点更像开盘前重新定价,价格稳住了,情绪却只有50/100的中性区。

二、资金在赌什么

$ETH这1.40%的反弹,最直观的含义是事件落地后,卖盘没有继续压穿2418。

但全网情绪卡在50,说明资金没有形成一致性贪婪,更多是在降杠杆、等方向。

现在把温和反弹直接叫反转,有点急。

真正有力的确认,得看价格能否持续站在2428上方,同时回调时2418还能接住。

三、多空分歧在哪

多头有底气,因为升息消息落地后,盘面仍守在7.63万至7.65万美元区域,风险没有扩散。

空头也没退场,中性情绪加上缺少追价意愿,很容易把反弹拖成区间震荡。

这里最怕的不是正常回踩,而是价格看似稳住,资金却逐步撤走。

接下来一边看2418附近的承接,一边看2428上方能否出现持续交易意愿,别只看单根K线。

四、接下来怎么做

我现在的判断很直接,这是事件落地后的修复,不是已经确认的单边行情。

已有仓位把2418和2428当成观察线,失守或假突破都先控风险,别跟一根早盘K线较劲。

没仓位的等回踩承接或突破后的二次确认,信号没齐就少操作,没必要替市场制造流动性。

消息才刚出炉半小时左右,早盘波动经常不完整,耐心比猜方向更值钱。

As a result, liquidity-sensitive assets like BTC and ETH saw funds drained, ETF flows continued to show net outflows, Ethereum’s staked funds were withdrawn, and the market shifted into a risk-off mode.
 
ZEC’s strength comes from two key drivers. First, the spot ETF from Grayscale has been approved, opening an entry channel for institutional capital. Second, the surge triggered a short-squeeze dynamic: ZEC rallied more than 20x from its low, leading to large-scale liquidations of shorts, and the resulting squeeze spiral pushed the price higher and higher.
 
However, it’s important to distinguish: this rally is narrative-driven rather than fundamentally driven. On-chain data shows that the usage of addresses that screen/avoid transactions has not grown in sync with the price. The more than 3 billion in daily trading volume is disconnected from real business demand. In essence, after capital rotated out of mainstream coins, investors grouped together to speculate on a niche narrative asset.
 
When BTC momentum fades, capital chooses ZEC for short-term trading and tactical bets. Markets powered by narrative and leverage can swing violently; investors should be alert to pullback risks caused by capital quickly withdrawing.

Circle公链Arc主网正式开放，贝莱德与Visa等出任创始验证者

Circle自研的Layer1网络Arc于9月16日正式开放公共主网。在Circle的全栈布局中，这条链与USDC、支付网络并列为核心基础设施：它不争夺DeFi流动性，而是一张面向稳定币、代币化现实资产与外汇清算的结算网络。项目2025年8月立项，10月开放测试网，今年5月以30亿美元估值完成2.22亿美元机构预售，a16z crypto领投7500万美元，贝莱德、纽交所母公司ICE等跟投。已确认的核心事实如下：主网链编号为5042；Gas直接以USDC支付，用户无须另持Gas代币；USDC与EURC通过官方跨链机制原生进出，由发行方销毁铸造完成，不依赖第三方桥保管资金；共识引擎Malachite提供确定性最终性，交易约350毫秒定案且不可逆。验证人集合目前完全封闭，贝莱德、DTCC、Visa、万事达卡、渣打等11家机构加Circle自身共12个节点——按BFT安全边界，其中4家串通即可令网络停摆。为什么Circle要自建链？三个结构性约束可以解释：企业用USDC结算须额外持有ETH或SOL，形成汇兑敞口与税务事项；以太坊类网络的概率性确认在清算业务的合同层面不成立，机构要求交易完成瞬间出具不可撤销凭证；底层链的硬分叉与Gas波动超出Circle风控范围。更深一层，已生效的稳定币联邦监管框架要求发行方履行反洗钱义务并禁止付息，Arc协议层内置的黑名单与审计轨迹正由此而来。换言之，其中心化程度存在法律设定的下限，批评它不够去中心化与辩护它本为机构而建，争论的其实是定义。把事实与预期分开看市场影响。事实是：ARC代币尚未发行、未启动TGE，Gas用USDC意味着ARC现阶段不直接捕获主网费用；官方积分体系明确不构成代币或空投承诺。预期是：此前Robinhood链上CASHCAT单周涨逾二十倍的记忆，驱使部分资金按meme链逻辑提前布局Arc生态，GMGN、OpenSea等平台已宣布接入，个别被热炒的早期代币持仓高度集中，风险可能先于机会暴露。机构叙事的真正变量在立法与清算迁移：托管机构计划2027年下半年将托管资产上链，该进度依赖市场结构立法提供法律确定性。编辑观察：按公链标准衡量Arc的抗审查性不及格，按「用区块链实现的机构清算网络」理解则设计自洽。评估它应看真实机构清算量与资产上链进度，而非地址活跃度或meme行情热度；在解锁与通胀参数披露前，任何流通市值估算都不成立。对普通用户而言，分清结算网络的长期价值与短线抢跑游戏的边界，比追逐叙事更重要。

#Circle开放Arc主网 #BTC #ETH #BNB

title: Tres criptomonedas con fundamentos sólidos para analizar
subTitle:
Cuando el mercado cae, importa distinguir entre un precio más bajo y un proyecto que realmente conserva valor. Estas tres criptomonedas tienen trayectoria y usos identificables, aunque no ofrecen el mismo nivel de riesgo:

1. Bitcoin — #BTC . Funciona desde 2009 y tiene un suministro máximo de 21 millones de monedas. Su trayectoria y diseño descentralizado respaldan su propuesta como activo digital escaso. Sin embargo, esa escasez no garantiza ganancias: necesita demanda y puede sufrir caídas profundas. [Binance Research](https://www.binance.com/en/research/projects/bitcoin)

2. Ether — #ETH . Es la moneda de Ethereum: permite pagar operaciones y contribuir a la seguridad de una red utilizada por aplicaciones financieras y otros servicios. Su fortaleza está en ese ecosistema y en una utilidad que va más allá de comprar para revender. Aun así, una red útil no garantiza que su moneda esté bien valorada ni que su precio se recupere rápidamente. [Binance Academy: Ethereum](https://www.binance.com/en/academy/articles/what-is-ethereum)
3. Solana — $SOL . Se utiliza para pagar transacciones y participar en la seguridad de una red de bajo costo, con aplicaciones financieras y de pagos. La consideraría una alternativa de mayor riesgo dentro de esta selección: tiene menos trayectoria y un historial de interrupciones, aunque ha incorporado mejoras de infraestructura. [Binance Academy: Solana](https://www.binance.com/en/academy/articles/what-is-solana-sol)
Una aclaración importante: ser un token no significa carecer de valor. La diferencia entre moneda y token es técnica —red propia o emisión sobre otra red—, no un certificado de calidad. Para evaluar solidez también importan la seguridad, el uso, la liquidez y la distribución de la oferta. [Binance Academy: monedas y tokens](https://www.binance.com/en/academy/glossary/coin)

Estos fundamentos justifican investigarlas, no comprarlas a cualquier precio. Incluso una criptomoneda consolidada puede seguir cayendo; cualquier entrada debería contemplar pérdidas y utilizar únicamente dinero que puedas permitirte perder.
Tras la Fed: cautela, sin una señal clara de compra
 La reacción inicial no confirma un desplome nuevo, pero tampoco que la corrección haya terminado. La Fed subió las tasas 0,25 puntos porcentuales, hasta 3,75–4,00 %. Sus proyecciones apuntan a otra subida este año, aunque no constituyen un compromiso. Mi interpretación: el entorno sigue siendo exigente para los activos de riesgo. Comunicado de la Fed⁠, proyecciones⁠.
BTC, ETH y WLD: comparación antes y después

Para una comparación verificable, estas son las cotizaciones posteriores de Binance con hora visible. Todos los precios están en dólares.
La referencia previa es nuestra consulta matutina, no el minuto anterior al anuncio. Las fuentes y horarios difieren, por lo que estos cambios son orientativos y no pueden atribuirse íntegramente a la Fed.

La secuencia de Bitcoin ilustra la incertidumbre: después del anuncio llegó aproximadamente a USD 76.300, pero posteriormente retrocedió hacia USD 75.400 durante la rueda de prensa. El primer rebote no se sostuvo en esa ventana. Seguimiento de CoinDesk⁠.
Lo que todavía pesa

ETF: el 15 de septiembre salieron USD 450,4 millones de los fondos de Bitcoin y USD 142,3 millones de los de Ethereum. Son datos anteriores a la decisión; los flujos completos del día 16 todavía no estaban publicados. No sería correcto presentarlos como ventas provocadas por la Fed. Farside: BTC⁠, ETH⁠.
Liquidaciones: el reporte matutino registró más de USD 570 millones en posiciones apalancadas liquidadas durante las 24 horas previas. No pude verificar una cifra fiable exclusivamente posterior al anuncio. CoinDesk⁠.Regulación: continúa la incertidumbre tras el revés de CLARITY. Como contrapunto, hoy avanzó en una comisión de la Cámara un proyecto sobre tributación cripto; todavía no es ley ni reemplaza el marco regulatorio pendiente. Detalle legislativo⁠.
¿Comprar o esperar?
Para una entrada importante, esperaría. Buscaría varias sesiones de estabilidad y una mejora de la demanda, incluidos los flujos de ETF. Una compra pequeña y escalonada de BTC o ETH puede encajar en un plan de largo plazo, usando dinero prescindible y sin apalancamiento; no elimina el riesgo de seguir perdiendo. En WLD sería más prudente: su estabilidad momentánea cerca de USD 0,37 no demuestra que haya encontrado un piso. La conclusión es acumulación limitada solo con un plan previo; no una compra impulsiva porque “ya bajó bastante”.

📰 Nvidia adds fuel to quantum computing: what exactly does CUDA-Q Logical solve for the bottleneck?

According to Crypto Briefing, Nvidia has announced an expansion of its open-source platform CUDA-Q, launching CUDA-Q Logical, which is specifically designed to address quantum error correction (QEC) problems. Put simply: quantum computers are inherently error-prone, and error correction is the biggest obstacle on the path to practical use. Nvidia is now opening up GPU compute power to help academia and enterprises run error-correction simulations. This is an action to “inject blood” into the entire quantum computing industry.

In-depth analysis

Why is it important?

The storyline of quantum computing over the past year has been “expectation → disillusionment → rebuilding.” After an early-year stock price hype rally, the market realized that practical application is much farther away than people thought. And error correction is the core bottleneck: maintaining a single logical qubit in a stable state requires hundreds or even thousands of physical qubits—who can balance that equation wins. By rolling out open-source toolchains, Nvidia effectively lowers the R&D barrier for the whole industry. This is an extension of the “selling shovels” logic—if quantum succeeds, GPU compute demand grows; if quantum doesn’t take off, the platform ecosystem also locks in researchers.

One-sentence translation: quantum computing isn’t at the money-making stage yet, but the infrastructure war has already begun.

Impact on the market

In the short term, the impact on crypto markets is limited, but there’s an unavoidable thread in the medium term: progress in quantum error correction increases the long-term threat coefficient for Bitcoin’s elliptic curve signatures. Of course, CUDA-Q Logical is only an error-correction simulation tool; it’s still a long way—ten thousand miles—from breaking cryptography. Don’t scare yourself.

subTitle:
CLARITY法案未通过
参议院程序性投票未能通过《CLARITY法案》，这是ETH本周最大的短期利空。法案失败后，ETH一度下探至 2388 美元，随后小幅反弹至2400附近。美国上市的现货以太坊ETF录得自1月以来最大单日流出，法案停滞是主要触发因素。
美联储加息落地，鹰派立场明确
美联储宣布将联邦基金利率上调至 3.75%-4%，为2023年以来首次加息。新主席Kevin Warsh明确表示"通胀过高且持续时间过长，今夏的通胀数据并未表明潜在趋势已明显改善"。加息落地后，比特币先跌后稳，周内累计下跌近4%。对ETH而言，高利率环境意味着流动性收紧，风险资产整体承压。
资金面：ETF流出 vs 机构抄底
散户在跑，机构在买——这与上次ETH回调时的信号如出一辙。
贝莱德今日从Coinbase Prime提取 5150枚ETH（约1228万美元），同时提取656.71枚BTC（约4979万美元），合计约6200万美元。在市场恐慌时逆势积累，这是机构对ETH中长期价值的认可。

以太坊生态：长期供给结构正在收紧
短期利空掩盖不了一个重要事实：ETH的链上供给正在持续收紧。
交易所储备降至1460万枚ETH，为2016年以来最低水平。自2022年以来储备持续下降，本周的流入量在这条长期趋势面前几乎可以忽略。质押总量达4300万枚ETH，创历史新高，约占供应量的 35%。质押中的ETH无法出售，可交易的ETH池子比以往任何周期都更小。MVRV比率已升至1以上，且ETH持续交易在约 2300美元的实现价格之上。分析师指出，若这一状态持续，6-7月可能已标记为本轮周期低点。
此外，以太坊主网已于9月16日正式上线多方区块构建机制（MPBC），这是PBS机制的重要演进，进一步优化了区块空间的协作与效率。

⚡ 清算地图：杠杆双向堆积，变盘一触即发
Coinglass数据显示，ETH当前处于双向清算密集区：
上方：若ETH突破 2528 美元，主流CEX累计空单清算强度将达 9.87亿美元——一旦突破，可能引发轧空加速上行。下方：若ETH跌破 2290 美元，累计多单清算强度将达 9.59亿美元——跌破则可能引发多头踩踏。
过去24小时，加密市场共有 2.6173亿美元 杠杆头寸被清算，其中空头占比 54.46%，约为多头的1.2倍，说明短期空头也在被挤压。

📋 操作参考（仅供参考，不构成投资建议）
偏多思路（超跌修复）：
入场参考：回踩 2355-2370 企稳轻仓试多，或有效突破 2439 后跟进。止损：2310 下方（4小时黄线）。目标：第一目标 2439-2460，站稳后看 2528（空头清算触发区）。
偏空思路（顺势）：
入场参考：反弹至 2439-2460 均线带遇阻轻仓试空。止损：2500 上方。目标：2355 → 2310 → 2290。
当前状态：2412处于短期均线下方、4小时支撑上方，属于宏观利空落地后的低位磨底阶段。追空空间有限（离2290清算区不远），追多需要等待均线修复信号。2355是关键观察位，守住则可能构筑短期底部，跌破则大概率测试2290清算密集区。

短期看宏观，中期看供给。 CLARITY法案失败+美联储鹰派加息，短期情绪确实偏空；但交易所储备十年新低、35%供应被锁定、机构逆势扫货，这些结构性信号才是决定ETH中期方向的关键。当前价格2412夹在短期均线（空）和4小时支撑（多）之间，变盘窗口正在收窄，重点关注2439的突破和2355的支撑表现。

According to a report by Binance Square, on September 9 the XRP ETF saw a single-day inflow of $12.29M, while the three U.S. DOGE funds combined over nearly 10 months only raised a little over $12M. Bitwise plans to shut down its BWOW DOGE ETF, which launched less than a year ago.

XRP is currently at $1.426, up 3.98% over 24h—capital inflows and price are validating each other. The impact on BTC/ETH is relatively neutral: BTC is mostly moving sideways around $77,887.1, and this news won’t change the broader market direction.

One-sentence translation: ETFs are not a magic cure-all. Institutional capital only cares about assets that have a spot-driven narrative and clear regulatory certainty. If you’re just pure meme trying to extend its life with an ETF, the market has already voted with its feet.

The deeper logic is simple: after clearing the same approval hurdle, XRP behind it has real settlement/payment use cases and clear expectations of SEC relationship repair. By contrast, the DOGE ETF is essentially a leveraged meme-sentiment product. A 10-month scale of $12M can’t even cover operating costs. Bitwise shutting it down is a rational risk-off decision, not a sign of the industry pivoting.

Testable inference: If, over the coming week, the XRP ETF keeps seeing daily inflows above $10M, then the $1.426 level is likely just a waystation; if inflows shrink to below $5M, or even flip to outflows, then this 3.98% rally is likely just a one-day phenomenon and the thesis falls apart. On the DOGE side, if the BWOW closure triggers a broader wave of liquidations across other altcoin ETFs, that would indicate the altcoin ETF window is narrower than people imagined.

Say I’m wrong—go easy on me. I’m only following the XRP funding-flow data with a small position and I’m not betting on DOGE.

XRP Ledger transaction volume hits a record—why do the numbers “made” by just 20 wallets hide a concern?

The number of transactions per single XRP Ledger transaction record has broken a historical record, but most of it is volume generated by 20 wallets, which is artificial heat for the short-term coin price.

According to Bitcoin.com, on September 13 the XRP Ledger block #106,965,249 packed 3,254 transactions, setting a new all-time high. But when you break it down, it exposes the trick: about 2,000 of them are completely identical “1 drop” payments (the smallest unit of XRP transfer, basically equal to zero), initiated by only 20 wallets. The XRP Ledger Foundation’s community director, Hussein Zangana, also confirmed this figure.

In plain terms, someone uses scripts to repeatedly send dust-level transfers, stacking the ledger’s transaction count sky-high.

One-sentence translation: This isn’t an ecosystem boom—it’s 20 addresses刷 KPI.

Market impact
- Short term: XRP is now $1.423, up 5.66% in 24h, the strongest among major coins. But if you treat this “record” as evidence of on-chain prosperity and chase it, you’re buying watered-down “meat” as if it were fresh snowflake beef. If you remove those roughly 2,000 junk transfers, the real usage is about 1,200 transactions—just normal to somewhat elevated.
- Medium term: The刷 volume itself isn’t necessarily bearish, but it exposes a problem—XRP Ledger’s performance narrative can be manipulated by data. When institutions conduct due diligence later, these inflated records will actually work against it. On-chain data should be assessed by its source and structure, not just the headline.

But global regulators all play by their own rules—one set in the U.S., another in the EU, and yet another across Asia. Compliance costs are so high that institutions don’t dare scale up. As a result, stablecoins’ share of global payments is only 3%, which doesn’t match their valuation in the hundreds of billions.

Medium term: This is the real focus. WTO-level officials publicly discussing stablecoins for cross-border payments shows that this issue has already made it onto the international agenda. If regulatory coordination moves forward, the 3% figure would be the starting point for breaking through that ceiling—stablecoin issuers and the public-chain ecosystem would be the biggest beneficiaries. Conversely, if countries keep bickering, stablecoins can only remain trapped in “trading-coin” scenarios.

According to Crypto Briefing, disruptions in oil supply push oil prices higher, intensifying inflation concerns. The market worries that monetary policy may be forced to tighten, putting pressure on gold and causing it to drop.

How does this flow into the crypto market?

💡 Negative outlook warning—the transmission path is quite specific: oil prices rise → inflation expectations increase → the central bank dares not cut rates and even reconsiders tightening → liquidity expectations contract → valuations for risk assets come under pressure, and BTC is hit first.

Gold’s drop is the key signal: even safe-haven assets are being sold, suggesting this is not a classic risk-hedging environment, but rather a rising real interest rate scenario—bond yields are climbing, the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets increases, and both BTC and gold fall into the same category of victims.

One-sentence translation: What the market fears isn’t inflation itself—it’s that inflation wipes out all the cards on the rate-cut table.

What this means for the market

BTC is currently at $78,176.66 (24h -1.73%), ETH at $2,515.44 (-1.57%). The relatively mild sell-off implies the selling pressure hasn’t fully kicked in yet; it looks more like a phase of expectation-driven trading. If oil prices keep surging and Fed officials start to sound hawkish, risk appetite may weaken before the data deteriorates.

For reference, in 2022: oil prices surged + aggressive rate hikes, and BTC was beaten along a “risk asset” logic all the way through. The difference from that time is that there’s currently no recession concern providing a cushion, but the common point is that the “inflation → tightening” chain directly attacks the risk premium.

My view: bearish in the short term. In the next 12 hours, BTC is likely to test the $76K area. ETH underperforms BTC over 24 hours; around $2,450 is the sentiment watershed. I’m 70% confident in this; the remaining 30% I’ll leave to the market—if I’m wrong, please go easy on me.

Invalidation conditions: if oil prices surge and then quickly retreat, or if the Fed clearly states it will “tolerate temporary inflation,” this negative thesis is immediately void. BTC could then potentially rebound as short-sellers cover into the vacuum.

事情怎么传导到币圈

💡 利空预警，传导路径很具体：油价涨 → 通胀预期抬头 → 央行不敢降息甚至重提紧缩 → 流动性预期收缩 → 风险资产估值承压，BTC首当其冲。

黄金跌是关键信号：连避险资产都被抛，说明这不是避险行情，而是实际利率上行行情——债券收益率涨，持有无息资产的机会成本变高，BTC和黄金属于同一类受害者。

一句话翻译：市场怕的不是通胀本身，是通胀把降息桌上的牌全收走。

BTC 现在报 $78,176.66（24h -1.73%），ETH $2,515.44（-1.57%），跌幅温和说明抛压还没真正到位，更像是预期博弈阶段。如果油价继续冲、联储官员开始放鹰，风险偏好会先于数据恶化。

La presión macroeconómica: Los mercados operan con cautela extrema ante la expectativa de las decisiones de tasas de interés de la Fed y unos rendimientos de bonos elevados que limitan el apetito por el riesgo.

Soporte crítico: La zona de $75,000 USD es el piso inmediato a defender; perderlo abriría espacio hacia los $71,000 y $67,000 USD.  
Resistencia a recuperar: Los compradores necesitan romper y consolidar de nuevo por encima de los $76,500 USD para calmar la volatilidad.  
Enfoque de trading: Con las liquidaciones al alza, el uso disciplinado de Stop Loss y una gestión estricta del apalancamiento son fundamentales para proteger el capital en los derivados.

Is crypto actually growing, or just getting more expensive?

Total value locked counts prices, not only deposits
TVL is the dollar value of every token parked inside a protocol's smart contracts. You get it by multiplying the number of tokens locked by what those tokens cost right now.

That's the trap CryptoSlate points at. A 20 billion jump can read as adoption while being mostly a revaluation of assets that were already sitting there. The way to separate the two is to watch token counts, not dollar figures.

title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
subTitle:
The IRS is finally getting a clearer picture of how to tax your crypto gains, and that means you might keep more of your hard‑earned profits.  
The new bill, passed by the House Committee, introduces a key exemption: qualifying crypto fees—like gas fees for transactions—are no longer counted as part of your gain or loss. That means if you buy $ETH, pay a small fee to move it, and then sell, the fee doesn’t inflate your taxable profit.  
At the same time, the bill tightens the “wash‑sale” rule for crypto. If you sell a token at a loss and then buy the same token back within 30 days, the loss can’t be deducted. This mirrors the traditional tax code for stocks, but it’s a big shift for crypto traders who often use quick flips to offset gains.  
Think of it like this: if you’re buying and selling a collectible card, you only pay tax on the profit, not the cost of shipping it. The new law does the same for crypto, but it also says you can’t claim a loss if you’re basically buying the card back right away.  
For everyday traders, this means:  
1. Keep a record of your gas fees separately; they won’t add to your taxable amount.  
2. Be mindful of the 30‑day rule—if you’re planning a loss‑harvesting strategy, you’ll need to wait longer before repurchasing the same token.  
3. Use tax software that supports crypto to automatically apply these rules.
